action_classes: rupa verify sheet write and delete command
extension.description: Reviews rupa commands that replace or delete local files the caller names: a render with --force, which can replace an existing file of any type, and `rupa verify --out DIR`, which writes and deletes review sheets in a chosen folder. A plain render is not matched, although it replaces an existing .html or .pdf without asking; `rupa --help` and `rupa --version` are read-only.
extension.name: rupa command protection

permissions.description: Identifies `rupa ... --force`. With --to, -o can name any path. If that file exists and isn't .html or .pdf, rupa refuses (exit 2) unless --force is given, and then replaces it: `rupa --to html --force -o notes.txt in.md` overwrites notes.txt. Covers the installed rupa script and `uv run rupa`, `uvx rupa` and `uv tool run rupa` launches. Known limit: a plain render without --force (`rupa in.md -o out.pdf`) is not matched, although it replaces an existing .html or .pdf at -o without asking; flagging it would review every normal run. `rupa verify` rejects --force (exit 2, nothing written), but a --force there is still matched: Guard compares arguments case-insensitively, and `rupa VERIFY --force ...` renders a file named VERIFY.
permissions.label: rupa forced output overwrite
safer_guidance: Drop --force and write to a new .html or .pdf path; without --force rupa refuses to replace any other existing file.
Check that -o does not name a file you want to keep before adding --force.

action_classes: rupa verify sheet write and delete command
permissions.description: Identifies `rupa verify PDF --out DIR`, which writes verify.json and sheet-p<NNN>-<kind>.png files into a folder the caller picks, replacing files with the same names, and deletes the sheets that the previous verify.json in that folder listed (only names matching sheet-p<digits>-<word>.png). Without --out the sheets go to <PDF>.verify/ beside the PDF and this rule does not match. Covers the installed rupa script and `uv run rupa`, `uvx rupa` and `uv tool run rupa` launches.
permissions.label: rupa verify sheets in a chosen folder
safer_guidance: Omit --out; rupa verify then writes its sheets to <PDF>.verify/ beside the PDF.
Point --out at a new, empty folder rather than one that holds other files.

cases.command: cd docs; rupa --force --to html -o notes.txt in.md
rupa --force --to pdf -o notes.txt in.md && rupa verify notes.txt
env RUPA_LOG=off rupa --force --to html -o notes.txt in.md
uv run rupa --force --to html -o notes.txt in.md
uv run --no-sync rupa in.md --to html -o notes.txt --force
uv run -- rupa in.md --to html -o notes.txt --force
uv tool run rupa --force --to html -o notes.txt in.md
echo in.md | xargs rupa --force --to html -o notes.txt
rupa verify --json --sample all --theme cyan --out review out/report.pdf
rupa in.md -o out/report.pdf && rupa verify out/report.pdf --out review
env RUPA_LOG=off rupa verify out/report.pdf --out review
uv run rupa verify out/report.pdf --out review
uv tool run rupa verify out/report.pdf --out=review
